name: MCP Link
notes: The repository contains the extension, server, store and release folders; the extension manifest requests debugger, scripting and tabs permissions on all URLs. Each tool can be set to ask every time or run automatically. Source code is under a proprietary view-only license and compiled apps under an EULA.
summary: A browser extension that lets chat AIs such as ChatGPT and Claude call user-approved MCP tools; with the companion MCP Link Server it adds automated browsing and web interactions.
